discrepancies.explanation: The reference asks 'How do I look?' but the translation says 'How do you teach?'.
The reference asks 'What is this TK app?' (or similar app name) which is mistranslated as 'Vedike app'.
The speaker's claim of being 'SC' (caste) is omitted in this line of the translation.
The reference says 'matha' (monastery/temple) but the translation says 'Betta' (hill).
The reference says 'I am at home, yes, I am at home' but the translation asks 'are there kids at home?'.
The reference says 'swear by touching' (idiomatic) but the translation says 'stay for tomorrow'.
